scope: Projection color reuse and directly related small regressions only; reuse the completed 18-01 baseline.

cache.scope: Private to the operational-map-projection module instance.
cache.lifetime: Module lifetime, with FIFO eviction before inserting beyond 512 entries.
cache.key: Current exact color string, without normalization.
cache.value: Only the successful frozen mapColorPresentation result; no world, country, cell or ownership references.
cache.hit: One Map lookup; no queue mutation or color contrast recalculation.
cache.validation: Every invocation still resolves and validates the ordinal, cell and current controller before lookup. Uncached colors use the original strict validation; failed calculations are never inserted.

cases: Shared colors across cells/countries and fresh complete return objects.
Color edits, undo/redo snapshots, occupation, liberation and ownership transfer.
Null controller neutral color, country retirement and recreation.
Warm-cache rejection of invalid ordinals, unknown/mismatched cells, missing controllers and invalid colors.
tests.environment: TEMP and TMP pointed to D:/gen/.tmp/prompt18-03b-vitest after the default sandbox temp path failed a rename with EPERM; the workspace-local retry passed. Existing Vite config native-loader compatibility warnings remain nonblocking.

verification.focusedLint: Passed for the two projection files.
verification.focusedTypecheck: Passed: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2017 --lib esnext,dom,dom.iterable --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler on the two projection files.

verification.performanceLimit: Calculation counts are small-fixture evidence only; no wall-time, FPS, CPU or memory improvement is claimed.
